candidate_rule.historical: Preserve all earlier verdicts including the historical strict insertion-rule failure. Do not apply this prospective rule retrospectively.
candidate_rule.inconclusive: If direction is favorable but no priority CI95 lower bound exceeds zero, report insufficient evidence and diagnose named failure modes. Do not rerun to search for a pass.
candidate_rule.insertions: Small insertion increases are analyzed separately and do not automatically veto a candidate. Report total and per-call insertion deltas, normalized insertion rate, affected entities/numbers and saved alignment examples.
candidate_rule.other_quality: Report non-entity, all entity classes, numeric value accuracy and semantic-high-impact errors. Any concentrated harm remains visible and requires root assessment before replication.
candidate_rule.promising: Require nonnegative natural-mixture point gains for both overall WER and PERSON, a strictly positive CI95 lower bound for at least one, and a strictly positive equal-call point gain for that supporting endpoint.
candidate_rule.purpose: Select whether a same-roster replication is justified; not a final effectiveness or generalization claim.
candidate_rule.stability: No stable-gain claim until a separately registered same-roster matched replication supports the conclusion. Owner GPU hold still governs all further contacts.
candidate_rule.tradeoff: If a priority endpoint worsens, report the full quality tradeoff for a named owner decision; do not silently retune thresholds or call it a pass.

contact_budgets.aggregate: Ceilings are not targets. No additional model contact is authorized by this document; use the first registered flight units for engineering observation rather than adding an undeclared screen.

direct.fit_basis: One props request plus3 endpoints for each of1593 real direct requests; shared fit_phase_runtime.

system.fit_basis: 1593*11*(one query packet +3 endpoints), charged only when the real contact is materialized.

cost.priority: Offline task quality; no online-latency veto.
report: Model loading and resident wall time
Actual core contacts and outputs by role, input/output tokens and speech exposure
Whisper cold calls, selected audio seconds, cache reuse and CPU wall time
GPU utilization integral and10-second utilization/power/slot/memory telemetry
Generation, CPU/tool wait, science wait, handoff and scoring-tail durations
Failures, retries, aborts and their consumed contacts
cost.system_total: Include all realized Perception, Solver, Reviewer, Planner and tool work, including fallback and failed contacts. Do not report only the final revision cost.

pipeline: Original/current speech OBS binding and selected intervals
Constructed and actually supplied ORG/SUPPLY values by call and role
Perception uncertainties, Reviewer findings, Planner routes and final Solver USE
Tool-request validity, cache hits, tool failures and returned evidence consumption
First Solver versus final Solver changes, saves and harms from saved scoring-compatible alignments
Output saturation, abstention, last-Solver fallback, contact exhaustion and complete44-call coverage
diagnostics.restriction: Do not equate tool call count, Reviewer confidence or ASR agreement with useful information gain. Do not claim neural RL or an optimized policy from root-authored prompts.
diagnostics.scope: Postseal descriptive attribution; selected-tool and revised subsets are policy-selected, not randomized causal contrasts.

estimators.equal_call: Average per-call rates over the prespecified eligible calls; report the denominator and zero-reference exclusions
estimators.equal_stratum: Average pooled rates across nonempty sector strata; report the separate equal-sample-rate result as sensitivity
estimators.gain_direction: Direct error rate minus system error rate; positive is better. Accuracy gains use system minus direct.
estimators.natural_mixture: Pool counts across all44 calls before division; do not average window WER
estimators.overall_wer: 100 * sum(substitutions + deletions + insertions) / sum(reference_words), from asr-wer-whisper saved per-call counts
estimators.person_wer: 100 * sum(PERSON errors) / sum(PERSON reference_words), using the registered ConEC scorer's saved PERSON bucket; never reconstruct a different entity scorer
estimators.strata: All sector and sample-rate strata from the frozen roster metadata, plus available source-metadata speaker strata; do not infer speakers from evaluation references
estimators.zero_reference: Report errors and reference counts. Mark an undefined rate/interval NA rather than zero; never discard a failed or empty system output.

future_optimization: After the base yields reproducible task gains, define trajectory sampling and training-free policy optimization over knowledge construction/consumption, Reviewer acquisition decisions and Planner revision choices. Root manual tuning is engineering, not algorithmic RL.
launch_conditions: Integrate reviewed shared implementation at a flight boundary and freeze its code version
Complete new exposure/fit/tool registrations and required attempt bindings
Root-owned decoder-only service matches the complete identity and exclusive lease
Direct whole-roster actual-request fit passes at the fixed geometry and4/3 reserve
System each actual contact passes registered fitting before generation; any refusal stops the flight, without reducing output cap or switching geometry
A2T predecessor is replicated or root-caused before admitting this new mechanism
matching: Same decoder/build/feature root, serving geometry, seed, temperature and1024 output cap
Same current-window geometry and transcription task contract
Same shared controller, FlightRuntime, OpenJiuwen executor, delivery and official scorers
Direct and system consecutively use one root-owned service process; any interruption stops dispatch and requires a prospective decision, never an automatic matched rerun

population.exclusions: None based on outcomes, tool use, saturation, revision, abstention or failure.

question: Does the complete frozen-core agent improve task-native transcription and PERSON quality over a new matched direct invocation?

resampling.descriptive_intervals: Also report CI90 for historical comparability, explicitly not the selection rule. All other intervals are descriptive.
resampling.equal_stratum_sensitivity: Use the shared stratified call resampler within source-metadata sector strata and compute an equal-sector pooled-rate statistic.
resampling.pairing: Use the same resampled44 call IDs in both arms; include all windows of each selected call.
resampling.priority_intervals: Report CI95 for overall WER gain and PERSON gain. Together these provide at least90% simultaneous coverage by Bonferroni; they are the only two priority tests.

runtime_boundaries: No reference transcripts, gold entity annotations or future turns enter runtime
Public ConEC participant and token/count sources are source-scoped external knowledge, not transcript truth
Whisper runs only for a Reviewer-selected current-window span; never as fixed ASR preprocessing
Perception and Solver have no analytical tool authority; Solver alone delivers the answer; Planner chooses ACCEPT or one bounded REVISE
No meeting-minutes, diarization or summary-quality claim

scoring.no_rescore: Saved-score analysis performs no reference-loader or official-scoring invocation.
scoring.policy: Run one complete44-call manifest per arm, one complete scoring job at a time. Preserve per-call counts and required alignments on the first score.
scoring.quality_read: Register the model-free paired read before opening quality-bearing files. Release neither arm's task accuracy until both are sealed or a formal terminal closure ends the comparison.
scoring.verification: Use core.bundle.verify_bundle and core.scoring_receipt.verify_complete_score_receipt; require exact paired roster, source identity, scorer identity and original artifact hashes.
scoring.windows: Use shared saved-score window decomposition only after verifying exact native delivery reconstruction. Extend the shared reader for native execution-unit receipts if needed; do not use legacy hard-coded historical verdict scripts.
